name: io.github.kelvinbiffi/ollos-mcp
description: Eyes and ears for AI agents: local, offline transcription, keyframes, on-screen text and a pre-publish review of any audio or video. Node only.

environmentVariables.name: OLLOS_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Where jobs, cache and models live. Default ~/.ollos

environmentVariables.name: OLLOS_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to forbid any network access (models must be warmed up first)

environmentVariables.name: OLLOS_YTDLP
environmentVariables.description: Path to a yt-dlp binary for video-site URLs (default: found on PATH)

environmentVariables.name: OLLOS_YTDLP_ARGS
environmentVariables.description: Allow-listed yt-dlp flags, e.g. --no-check-certificates behind a TLS-intercepting proxy
